blacklist_devices.description: List of device identifiers (e.g., WWIDs or vendor/product strings) to explicitly blacklist.

blacklist_devnodes.description: List of devnode patterns (e.g., 'sd[a-z]', 'dm-*') to blacklist.

blacklist_exceptions.description: Devices explicitly allowed despite matching blacklist rules.

blacklist_wwids.description: List of specific WWIDs to exclude from multipathing.

defaults_.description: Global default settings applied when no device block matches.

checker_timeout.description: Path checker timeout in seconds (overrides device-mapper default).

dev_loss.description: Maximum time to lose a path before discarding it (seconds).

io_timeout.description: I/O timeout for device-mapper devices in seconds.

max_fds.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors for multipathd (0 = unlimited).

no_path_retry.description: Default action when no paths available.

queue_without_daemon.description: Queue I/Os if multipathd is not running (yes/no).

retain_hwhandler.description: Default: retain hardware handler from driver (yes/no).

user_friendly_names.description: Use user-friendly device names (e.g., 'mpath1') instead ofWWIDs (yes/no).

devices.description: List of device-specific multipath configurations. Each entry overrides defaults for matching devices.

failback.description: Path group failback policy: 'immediate', 'manual', 'random', or number of seconds.

hw_handler.description: Hardware-specific handler (e.g., '0' for none, 'emc' for CLARiiON, 'alua' for ALUA).

no_path_retry.description: Action when no paths available: 'fail', 'queue', or number of retries (e.g., '30').

pg_timeout.description: Path group timeout in seconds (0 = disable).

prio_args.description: Additional arguments for the selected prio algorithm.

retain_hwhandler.description: Retain hardware handler from driver: 'yes' or 'no'.

logging.description: Logging configuration for multipath and multipathd.

daemon_log_level.description: Daemon-specific log level (0–4). Higher = more detail.

verbosity.description: Logging verbosity level (0–5). Higher = more detail.

watchdog.description: Optional watchdog daemon settings (for kernel-based watchdog support).

interval.description: Interval between watchdog pings in seconds.

timeout.description: Watchdog timeout in seconds before reboot.
